'''Teggi fungal root''' was a kind of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that grew in the mud of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antiquity]]. It was one of the main ingredients of [[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha fodder]].
